definitions.gloss: somewhat, to some extent, a little
definitions.explanation: To a moderate or limited degree; not completely but noticeably.
A portion or share of something (less common).

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{幾分|いくぶん}⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧。
⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧{幾分|いくぶん}⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I feel somewhat better after taking the medicine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{幾分|いくぶん}⟦{冷|つめ}たかった→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧。
⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幾分|いくぶん}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貯金|ちょきん}している→貯金：03497_chokin⟧。
examples.english: I save a portion of my salary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幾分|いくぶん}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{還元|かんげん}される→還元：08021_kangen⟧。
examples.english: A portion of the profits is returned to the employees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幾分|いくぶん}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}して→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The company covers a portion of the costs.

notes:
USAGE: {幾分|いくぶん} is a slightly formal adverb indicating a moderate degree. It's softer than ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧ and more formal.

POSITION: Usually appears before the word it modifies.

REGISTER: Slightly formal; more common in written language.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧ - a little (more casual, common)
- ⟦やや→やや：03642_yaya⟧ - slightly (similar formality)
- ⟦{多少|たしょう}→多少：01647_tashou⟧ - more or less, somewhat
- ⟦いくらか→いくらか：21790_ikuraka⟧ - somewhat (similar meaning)
